## MCP tools (live)

When feel-your-protocol MCP is connected:

- describe_capabilities — probe registry (forks, runnable EIPs, opcodes, encoding, spec snapshot)
- run_bytecode — raw bytecode under a fork; optional accounts[] prestate
- run_transaction — paid tx gas, receipts, wallet gasLimit, contract creation
- run_block — 1–8 txs as a lab block; optional header slot / number / timestamp
- generate_artifact — lab BAL (EIP-7928) and later artifacts
- inspect_artifact — structure/hash on caller-supplied blobs; no chain state

Default fork: glamsterdam (alias amsterdam). Use fusaka for current mainnet EL or compare runs.

## Reference

- [EIP catalogue](https://mcp-docs.feelyourprotocol.org/use/coverage.html)

- Tool schemas under /use/tools/ and /schemas/*.input.json

## Connected agents

1. Trust listTools + describe_capabilities over markdown when MCP works.
2. Probe before run. Caller supplies bytecode/tx/prestate — no demo programs shipped.
3. Reply to humans in plain language; hide tool names and JSON unless asked.
4. Cite provenance.engineVersion and provenance.forkConfig. On EIP-specific answers, mention spec snapshot once (status, date, test release from eips[] row or provenance.caveat Spec:).
5. Do not substitute mcp-execution-engine lab or npm run lab when MCP is available.

Full rules and use-layer text: [llms-full.txt](https://mcp-docs.feelyourprotocol.org/llms-full.txt)
